svg.text: Yellow-Green-Blue — blank ΔE ladder, arc-length (ΔE-uniform) axis
Same real arc and anchors as the standard ladder — only the horizontal axis changed. Equal steps across the page now mean roughly equal real colour
distance everywhere. Place a real pencil by eye: which row (ΔE/direction) and which u (position left-right) does it look closest to? Report as e.g. "ΔE 11 tint, u=0.7".
